comment: Authoritative collection/artifact runs only. Debug and throwaway smokes are not registered; anything absent here carries no authority. data/ is gitignored, so this registry is the durable index. A registry-tombstone retains provenance after operator-approved byte cleanup; its root is not expected to exist.

runs.notes: Fresh strict-v10 R2R recollection after removing deferred D and the legacy Q/probe/projection/review branches. Four one-record shards validate cleanly; candidate replay is 1.0 and is a scorer-integrity check, not a benchmark result. Superseded by the conseq.v11 corpus: v11 replaced the per-run action bank digest with a per-pose materialized bank and moved action-policy authority into the run contract, so these records are no longer revalidatable and the manifest exits 2 rather than running.
runs.fixture_role: Deterministic input corpus for scripts/check_abc_golden.py. Four single-record shards over one scene, hand-fixed so the gate is reproducible: main-safe-r00 draws balanced actions, while the A3, B and C1 shards pin an explicit action file and B additionally pins a pose exclusion.
runs.not_a_sampling_source: Its coverage is the size of the gate, not of the benchmark. It is hand-selected and must never be reported as a sampled distribution or used to estimate per-task yield.

runs.notes: Recollection of the same four shards under conseq.v11 and the depth-conditioned action proposal, on regenerated pose pools whose poses are identical to v10's (same positions, yaws and geometry digests; only the code-revision binding changed). Coverage is unchanged at 10/2/2/2/2/6 and candidate replay is 1.0, which is a scorer-integrity check rather than a benchmark result. The 2026-08-07 golden freezes the intentional QA-policy, public-contract, and diagnostic-report changes while preserving these record inputs.
runs.fixture_role: Deterministic input corpus for scripts/check_abc_golden.py, covering both action-sampling policies: main-safe-r00 is balanced and declares depth_conditioned_action_proposal_v1 (three depth-conditioned pairs materialised, one reaching selection), while the A3, B and C1 shards pin an explicit action file and declare explicit_action_file_v1; B additionally pins a pose exclusion.
runs.not_a_sampling_source: Its coverage is the size of the gate, not of the benchmark. It is hand-selected and must never be reported as a sampled distribution or used to estimate per-task yield.

runs.notes: Two current-format R2R records freeze the sole counterfactual C1 route together with A1/A2/A3/B1/B2. The fixture validates the deterministic build and scorer replay; it is not evidence of task yield or C1 scientific readiness.
runs.fixture_role: Deterministic two-record source for scripts/check_abc_golden.py. It covers all six active tasks without a strict/matched future-view selector or future-view gate.
runs.not_a_sampling_source: Its 47-item coverage is the size of the regression gate, not a sampled benchmark distribution.

runs.notes: Active compact three-dataset Golden. It freezes deterministic construction, source binding and GT-as-pred replay; its 182 items are a regression fixture, not a yield estimate or benchmark result.
runs.not_a_sampling_source: Its coverage is the size of the regression gate, not a sampled benchmark distribution.

runs.notes: Completed post-fix Q8 supplement collected with inline pose discovery. Retained for audit and candidate comparisons, but formal-sources v3 excludes it because no authenticated shared pose pool backs the shards.

Preregistered three-backend, 20-scene Q8 direction and occlusion pilot. FOV realized wide-only witnesses: HM3D 20, R2R 17, GS 8; narrow-only: 0 on all backends, so narrow-only remains diagnostic-only. Occlusion witnesses: HM3D 3, R2R 6, GS 0; these establish feasibility but do not satisfy three-backend primary support.

First oracle-v6 full collection, produced with inline pose discovery. Superseded by the breaking oracle-v7 GT contract; its Q8 shards are additionally sampling-biased. Retained for audit and candidate comparisons, but formal-sources v3 excludes every shard.
Interrupted pose-pool-v1 collection. It produced no authoritative records and was never compiled; retained only to preserve the sampling transition audit trail.

Candidate v14 atlas retained for audit provenance and paper-page visual references. Its release gate has not passed, and neither candidate counts nor GT-as-pred outputs are benchmark results; no numbers from this artifact may be cited.
Pre-oracle-v6 candidate preview once served on port 8772. Legacy design reference only; the running viewer process must not be restarted against current code (contract gate would refuse it).
v1.3.1a preview, graded candidate by the v1.3.3 execution-regime audit (Q9 label collapse, Q6 all-closer). Numbers must not be cited.

Zero-yield directed witness run that triggered the proposal redesign. The registered root was absent at the 2026-08-09 freeze. This entry is a tombstone only: it must not be redirected to v1333_directed_smoke_755751c or any other smoke run.

Authenticated recovery snapshot of the interrupted train-seen collection. Exactly 445 previously rejected transaction bindings were re-derived from their sealed spool contracts; 562 source shards and 10,028 records compiled with zero recovery rejection. This is a retained training-data snapshot, not a completed 200K run or a benchmark result.
